name: Switch Order 8
definition: Transfer from one investment fund/fund class to another investment fund or investment fund class by the investor. A switch is composed of one or several subscription legs, and one or several redemption legs.

MasterReference.name: Master Reference
MasterReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a group of individual orders, as assigned by the instructing party. This identifier links the individual orders together.

OrderDateTime.name: Order Date Time
OrderDateTime.definition: Date and time the order is placed by the investor or its agent.

PlaceOfTrade.name: Place Of Trade
PlaceOfTrade.definition: Market in which the advised trade transaction was executed.

OrderReference.name: Order Reference
OrderReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the order, as assigned by the instructing party.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous investor's identification of the order. This reference can typically be used in a hub scenario to give the reference of the order as assigned by the underlying client.

NonceIdentification.name: Nonce Identification
NonceIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of a random or semi-random number used once (NONCE) generated in the frame of a cryptographic communication.

InvestmentAccountDetails.name: Investment Account Details
InvestmentAccountDetails.definition: Account impacted by the investment fund order.

RequestedFutureTradeDate.name: Requested Future Trade Date
RequestedFutureTradeDate.definition: Future date at which the investor requests the order to be executed.|The specification of a requested future trade date is not allowed in some markets. The date must be a date in the future.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money paid /to be paid or received in exchange for the financial instrument in the individual order.

CashSettlementDate.name: Cash Settlement Date
CashSettlementDate.definition: Date on which cash is available.

SettlementMethod.name: Settlement Method
SettlementMethod.definition: Method by which the transaction is settled.

AdditionalAmount.name: Additional Amount
AdditionalAmount.definition: Choice between additional cash in or resulting cash out.

ExpiryDateTime.name: Expiry Date Time
ExpiryDateTime.definition: Date on which the order expires.

CancellationRight.name: Cancellation Right
CancellationRight.definition: Cancellation right of the investor with respect to the investment fund order.

RedemptionLegDetails.name: Redemption Leg Details
RedemptionLegDetails.definition: Part of the investment fund switch order that is a redemption.

SubscriptionLegDetails.name: Subscription Leg Details
SubscriptionLegDetails.definition: Part of the investment fund switch order that is a subscription.

CashSettlementDetails.name: Cash Settlement Details
CashSettlementDetails.definition: Payment process for the transfer of cash from the debtor to the creditor.

ForeignExchangeDetails.name: Foreign Exchange Details
ForeignExchangeDetails.definition: Information needed to process a currency exchange or conversion.|Information needed to process a currency exchange or conversion.|How the exchange rate is expressed determines which currency is the Unit Currency and Quoted Currency. If the amounts concerned are EUR 1000 and USD 1300, the exchange rate may be expressed as per either of the following examples:|EXAMPLE 1 |UnitCurrency EUR|QuotedCurrency USD|ExchangeRate 1.300|EXAMPLE 2|UnitCurrency USD|QuotedCurrency EUR|ExchangeRate 0.769.

FinancialAdvice.name: Financial Advice
FinancialAdvice.definition: Specifies if advice has been received from an independent financial advisor.

NegotiatedTrade.name: Negotiated Trade
NegotiatedTrade.definition: Specifies whether the trade is negotiated.

CustomerConductClassification.name: Customer Conduct Classification
CustomerConductClassification.definition: Assessment of the customer’s behaviour at the time of the account opening application.

TransactionChannelType.name: Transaction Channel Type
TransactionChannelType.definition: Means by which the investor or account owner submits the open account form.

FinancialInstrumentQuantity1Rule.definition: If SubscriptionLegDetails/FinancialInstrumentQuantityChoice is not present, then RedemptionLegDetails/FinancialInstrumentQuantityChoice is mandatory in each occurrence of RedemptionLegDetails.|If SubscriptionLegDetails/FinancialInstrumentQuantityChoice is present, then it must be present in each occurrence of SubscriptionLegDetails.

InvestmentAccountDetailsRule.definition: Either InvestmentAccountDetails or all occurrences of SubscriptionLegDetails/InvestmentAccountDetails and RedemptionLegDetails/InvestmentAccountDetails must be present, but not both.|Either InvestmentAccountDetails or all occurrences of SubscriptionLegDetails/InvestmentAccountDetails and RedemptionLegDetails/InvestmentAccountDetails must be present, but not both.

OrderOriginatorEligibility3Rule.definition: Either InvestmentAccountDetails/OrderOriginatorEligibility or a single occurrence of RedemptionLegDetails/InvestmentAccountDetails/OrderOriginatorEligibility or a single occurrence of SubscriptionLegDetails/InvestmentAccountDetails/OrderOriginatorEligibility should be only present.
